title_sq: Vile 2 Kateshe ne Shitje ne Rrugen e Elbasanit, prane Vilave Amerikane ne Tirane (ID 4151191)
description_sq:
Vile 2 kateshe per shitje ne rrugen 3 Vellezerit Kondi ne Tirane.
Ndodhet ne nje zone te qete dhe me ajer te paster.
Ka nje siperfaqe totale trualli prej 542 m2 dhe siperfaqe ndertimi prej 226 m2 e cila organizohet ne 2 kate si me poshte:
Kati pare: jane dy apartamente te ndara secila me sallon me kuzhine te perbashket, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe ballkon.
Kati dyte: ndahet ne nje dhome garsoniere dhe nje apartament i vecuar me sallon me kushine te perbashket, nje dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon.
Ambienti ofrohet i mobiluar me kushte bashkekohore.
Ka te instaluar 1 kondicioner ne sallon ne katin e dyte per ngrohjen dhe ftohjen.
Orientimi i viles eshte jug-lindje dhe veri-perendim.
Perreth viles ka nje oborr te madhe te mbjelle me peme dhe lule te ndryshme.
Ka akses ne rrugen Gasper Guga, rrugen Fuat Toptani, rrugen Vehbi Hoxha, rrugen e Elbasanit etj.
Prona ka certifikate pronesie.
Cmimi: 450.000 Euro
title_en: 2-Storey Villa for Sale in Elbasan Street, near American Villas in Tirana (ID 4151191)
description_en: 2-storey villa for sale at 3 Vellezerit Kondi street in Tirana. It is located in a quiet area with clean air. It has a total land area of ​​542 m2 and a building area of ​​226 m2, which is organized on 2 floors as follows: First floor: there are two separate apartments, each with a living room with a common kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. Second floor: it is divided into a studio room and a separate apartment with a living room with a common pillow, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony. The environment is offered furnished with contemporary conditions. There is 1 air conditioner installed in the living room on the second floor for heating and cooling. The orientation of the villa is south-east and north-west. Around the villa there is a large yard planted with different trees and flowers. There is access to Gasper Guga Street, Fuat Toptani Street, Vehbi Hoxha Street, Elbasani Street, etc. The property has ownership certificates. Price: 450,000 Euros
